package com.imthec4.customstatlayout;

import net.runelite.client.RuneLite;
import net.runelite.client.externalplugins.ExternalPluginManager;

/**
 * Starts the normal RuneLite client with this plugin compiled in, which is how a plugin
 * is run before it goes through the plugin hub. Assertions must be enabled (-ea) or
 * loadBuiltin refuses to run.
 */
public class CustomStatLayoutLauncher
{
	public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception
	{
		ExternalPluginManager.loadBuiltin(CustomStatLayoutPlugin.class);
		RuneLite.main(args);
	}
}
